items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Blue, they tell me his daddy was a trumpet player, Walter Blue, years ago.

ctx.x: I don't know him, but I've heard of him.
Yeah, that's all I've been knowing about. Blue, they tell me his daddy was a trumpet player, Walter Blue, years ago.
Oh, Blue would probably be his last name then, huh?
